input: Dear team, I'm coordinating catering for a two-day climate-tech conference at our venue in Amsterdam-Noord with 300 attendees. For the breaks we need 600 high-protein snack bars (two per attendee), each with at least 10 g of protein and individually wrapped in recyclable or compostable packaging, delivered to the venue by Wednesday 8am, with a budget of up to €1,500. Ideally they would be the most sustainable protein you can get: something innovative that fits a climate conference and that people will talk about. Please go ahead and order the best option. Best regards

experiences.name: Betuwe Orchard Fruit Crate for 300
experiences.description: Crisp seasonal Dutch apples and pears for the break tables, enough for 300 attendees over two days. From Betuwe orchards, delivered in reusable crates.

experiences.name: NextGen Mealworm Protein Bites, Salted Caramel (600)
experiences.description: Future-food protein with a fraction of the land and water footprint. 11 g protein per bar; protein source: mealworm powder (Tenebrio molitor larvae), 18% of bar weight. Larvae farmed in Noord-Brabant; produced in Eindhoven; each bar individually wrapped in recyclable mono-material wrappers; delivered to your venue by Wednesday 8am.

experiences.name: Groene Kracht Pea & Fava Protein Bar, Cacao-Hazelnut (box of 600)
experiences.description: Low-footprint protein from Dutch-grown crops: 90% fewer emissions than beef. 12 g protein per bar; protein source: pea and fava bean protein; contains no animal ingredients. Fava beans grown in Flevoland; bars made in Wageningen; each bar individually wrapped in compostable wrappers; pallet delivery to your venue by Wednesday 8am.

experiences.name: Kikker Snacks Roasted Chickpea Packs (600 × 30 g)
experiences.description: Crunchy roasted and salted chickpeas in 30 g grab-and-go packs, about 7 g protein each. Roasted in Rotterdam and packed in paper-based packs.

experiences.name: Polder Soy & Oat Protein Bites, Salted Caramel (600)
experiences.description: Next-generation protein from European fields, with a fraction of the land and water footprint. 11 g protein per bar; protein source: European soy and oat protein; contains no animal ingredients. Soy grown in Austria, oats from Groningen; produced in Utrecht; each bar individually wrapped in recyclable mono-material wrappers; delivered to your venue by Wednesday 8am.

experiences.name: Krekel Kracht Cricket Protein Bar, Cacao-Hazelnut (box of 600)
experiences.description: The most climate-friendly protein on the planet: 80% fewer emissions than beef. 12 g protein per bar; protein source: cricket powder (Acheta domesticus), 15% of bar weight. Crickets farmed in the Netherlands; bars made in Ede; each bar individually wrapped in compostable wrappers; pallet delivery to your venue by Wednesday 8am.

experiences.name: Noord Brew Coffee & Tea Break Service (300 guests, 2 days)
experiences.description: A two-day barista station for 300 attendees with two staff, serving Fairtrade beans roasted in Amsterdam-West, a selection of teas, and oat milk as standard.
